title: Environment Variables [env, export]
description:
# Environment Variables
Environment variables are key-value pairs available to all programs in your shell.

```bash
env                        # list all env vars
echo $HOME                 # print one
export MY_VAR="hello"      # create one
echo $MY_VAR               # hello
```

Important ones:
- `$HOME` - your home directory
- `$PATH` - where the shell looks for programs
- `$USER` - your username

`export` makes the variable available to child processes. Without `export`, it only exists in the current shell.
